FOLDER TEMPLATE POSTER / ALBUM ART MUSISI
=========================================
Silakan masukkan file poster / album art musisi kamu ke dalam folder ini:
Path: public/assets/musicians/

Daftar nama file default:
1. the-beatles.jpg (atau .png, .webp)
2. the-beach-boys.jpg
3. pink-floyd.jpg
4. queen.jpg
5. michael-jackson.jpg
